issue: NoSQL injection via unsanitized regex in product search
recommendation: Escape special regex characters from req.query.keyword using a helper like escapeRegex() before passing to $regex, or use $text index search instead.

issue: IDOR — any authenticated user can view any order by ID without ownership check
evidence: const order = await Order.findById(req.params.id).populate('user', 'name email') — no check that order.user === req.user._id
recommendation: Add ownership verification: if (order.user._id.toString() !== req.user._id.toString() && !req.user.isAdmin) return 403.

issue: IDOR — any authenticated user can mark any order as paid without ownership check
evidence: updateOrderToPaid: Order.findById(req.params.id) without verifying req.user owns the order
recommendation: Verify order ownership before allowing payment status update.

issue: No rate limiting on login endpoint — brute-force attack vector
recommendation: Add express-rate-limit middleware (e.g. 5 attempts per 15 min per IP) to POST /login.

issue: No rate limiting on registration endpoint — mass account creation possible
recommendation: Add rate-limit middleware to POST /api/users registration endpoint.

issue: Feature flag state mutation endpoints have no authentication — any client can change feature flags
evidence: router.post('/state', ...) and router.post('/traffic', ...) — no protect/admin middleware
recommendation: Add protect and admin middleware to POST /state and POST /traffic routes.

issue: No password strength validation on registration
evidence: const user = await User.create({ name, email, password }) — password accepted as-is
recommendation: Validate minimum password length (8+ chars), complexity requirements before creating user.

issue: No password strength validation on profile update
recommendation: Apply same password validation rules as registration.

issue: Stack traces exposed in non-production environments
evidence: stack: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? null : err.stack — exposes internals in dev/staging if NODE_ENV not set
recommendation: Default to hiding stack traces: only show when NODE_ENV is explicitly 'development'.

issue: PayPal Client ID exposed via unauthenticated endpoint
recommendation: While PayPal client IDs are semi-public, restrict endpoint to authenticated users or embed in frontend build config.

issue: Client-supplied prices trusted without server-side recalculation
evidence: itemsPrice, taxPrice, shippingPrice, totalPrice taken directly from req.body
recommendation: Recalculate prices server-side from orderItems and product DB prices. Never trust client-submitted totals.

issue: No file size limit on image uploads
evidence: const upload = multer({ storage, fileFilter }) — no limits: { fileSize: ... } configured
recommendation: Add limits: { fileSize: 5 * 1024 * 1024 } (5MB) to multer configuration.

issue: JWT verification error details logged to console
evidence: console.error(error) — in auth middleware catch block, may log sensitive token data
recommendation: Log only error.message, not the full error object which may contain token details.

issue: Admin can set isAdmin flag on any user without audit trail
evidence: user.isAdmin = req.body.isAdmin — direct assignment from request body
recommendation: Add audit logging for admin privilege changes. Consider requiring confirmation or separate endpoint.

issue: No request body size limit configured
recommendation: Add body size limit: app.use(express.json({ limit: '10kb' })) to prevent large payload DoS.

evidence: No helmet or equivalent security headers middleware configured
recommendation: Add helmet middleware for security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, etc.).

issue: No file locking on features.json — race condition on concurrent writes
evidence: _load() and _save() without file lock — concurrent MCP calls and Express route writes can corrupt
recommendation: Use file locking (fcntl.flock or filelock library) in _save() to prevent concurrent write corruption.

issue: Request body logged to console on feature flag state change
recommendation: Remove or reduce debug logging in production code paths.
